info.title: The scale codes of org.openmixer.param-contract/1: the code a plugin's get() reports for how a parameter is drawn, and the standard scale each stands for

OMX_CLAP_SCALE_CODES.description: The scale codes of org.openmixer.param-contract/1, by standard scale id: the code its get() reports for how a parameter's plain value lies along its position. The key is a word of omx-contract's PARAM_SCALES (the F2 mapping), the code is this extension's own, append-only.

x-docs.linear: the value is linear in position
x-docs.log: geometric in position, both bounds positive
x-docs.stepped: the whole numbers from min to max, CLAP_PARAM_IS_STEPPED, step 1

banner: Rendered from OMX_CLAP_SCALE_CODES of the omx-clap-scale domain: the scale codes of org.openmixer.param-contract/1.
A plugin includes this header for the codes its get() reports; the key of each code is a standard scale id of omx-contract's PARAM_SCALES.
c.brief: The scale codes of the parameter contract extension, one OMX_CLAP_SCALE_ define per standard scale id.

numbers.comment: how a parameter's plain value is laid out along its position: the code is this extension's, the word a PARAM_SCALES id
